reason: Classified as a media interaction utility because the plugin’s primary user-facing function is voice-based chat interaction—adding speech input and read-aloud controls to the DSH Web interface via injected client-side UI slots and browser speech APIs, rather than coding, testing, analysis, or external workflow orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web 聊天界面，新增语音输入与回复朗读功能，提供手动/自动播放及音色、语速、语调等设置入口。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web adds speech input and response read-aloud capabilities, with manual/auto playback and configurable voice, speed, and pitch settings in the chat interface.

capabilities: Speech-to-text input via browser SpeechRecognition in the DSH web client
Text-to-speech playback via browser speechSynthesis for assistant replies
UI injection of voice input/settings and assistant read-aloud controls into chat interface
Persistent storage of voice preferences using localStorage
Detection of new assistant messages to avoid duplicate automatic playback

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds microphone-driven text input and read-aloud reply features, with auto-read and manual controls.
README explains browser API integration using SpeechRecognition and speechSynthesis plus voice-rate-pitch settings.
Package metadata marks this as a web client plugin with bundle patch wiring and no declared runtime dependencies.
Repository tree exposes host/client plugin structure and manifest references required for DSH web injection.
